title: Invalid evidence anchors stay report-only diagnostics and never create repair work.
purpose: When a clause evaluation cites an anchor whose span is out of range or whose quote does not match the evaluated prose, the finding is downgraded to a report-only diagnostic: no Critique, no Repair Preview, no Issue (ADR 0008/0019).

clauses.statement: A weapon that leaves a hand is re-acquired before it is used again.

satisfaction_criterion.statement: Prose shows the weapon returning to the wielder's control before the next strike with it.

prose: He knocked the blade from her grip. It skittered under the cart. She raised her fists.

invalid_anchor.quote: a line that is not in the prose
